title: International Conference on Multidisciplinary Research
summary: GIRSD's flagship multidisciplinary conference bringing together researchers, academics and industry professionals across engineering, sciences, management and the humanities to present peer-reviewed work and build cross-disciplinary collaborations.
description: ICMDR 2026 is a one-day international multidisciplinary research conference hosted in partnership with CMS College of Engineering, Chennai. The conference welcomes original research across all disciplines and provides a platform for scholars, doctoral candidates and industry practitioners to present and publish their work. Accepted papers are peer-reviewed, and selected papers are recommended for publication in partner journals. The programme features keynote addresses, parallel technical sessions, a research poster exhibition and structured networking.
themes: Computer science, AI and data analytics

title: International Conference on Research Innovation in Engineering & Technology
summary: GIRSD's flagship two-day conference bringing together researchers, industry engineers and doctoral candidates to present peer-reviewed work across engineering and emerging technology.
description: ICRIET 2026 is the seventh edition of GIRSD's flagship research conference. Accepted papers undergo double-blind peer review by our international research review committee, and selected papers are recommended for publication in partner journals indexed in Scopus and Web of Science. The programme combines keynote addresses, parallel technical sessions, a doctoral symposium and a poster exhibition, with structured networking sessions on both days.

Renewable energy systems and sustainable engineering
Data science, IoT and cyber-physical security

title: International Conference on Applied Sciences & Humanities
summary: A one-day multidisciplinary conference connecting applied sciences with the humanities and social sciences, welcoming empirical, theoretical and practice-based contributions.
description: ICASH 2026 provides a platform for cross-disciplinary dialogue. The conference welcomes research in education, psychology, business, linguistics, public health and the applied sciences. All accepted abstracts are published in the conference proceedings with an ISBN, and full papers may be submitted to affiliated open-access journals. Early-career researchers benefit from a dedicated mentoring clinic during the lunch interval.

title: Academic Writing & Publication Masterclass
summary: An intensive one-day workshop taking researchers from manuscript structure to journal submission, led by experienced journal editors and peer reviewers.
description: This hands-on masterclass is limited to 30 participants to guarantee individual feedback. Participants work on their own draft manuscripts through structured exercises covering argument construction, literature positioning, responding to reviewers, and avoiding common desk-rejection triggers. Every attendee leaves with a personalised submission plan and three months of email follow-up support from the facilitation team.
themes: Selecting and targeting the right journal

title: International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Emerging Technologies & Digital Transformation 2027
summary: International conference bringing together researchers, academicians, industry experts, and students to present innovative research in Artificial Intelligence, Digital Transformation, Data Science, Cybersecurity, IoT, and emerging technologies.
description:
The International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Emerging Technologies & Digital Transformation (ICAIET 2027) is a premier international research conference organized by the Global Institute of Research & Skills Development (GIRSD).

The conference provides a multidisciplinary platform for researchers, academicians, engineers, innovators, policymakers, and industry professionals to present original research, exchange ideas, and discuss the latest developments in artificial intelligence and digital innovation.

Participants will benefit from keynote speeches, technical sessions, panel discussions, workshops, networking opportunities, and publication support through internationally recognized journals and conference proceedings.

The conference welcomes original research papers, review papers, case studies, and industry presentations from universities, research institutions, government organizations, and private industries worldwide.
